clips.title: The story
paras: A dispatch carries you from Darnassus to Darkshore, where Onu waits in the Grove of the Ancients. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm sends you across the sea with correspondence for the Ancient of Lore, who lives south of Auberdine.

After you help with matters at the Oracle Glade atop Teldrassil, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm summons you for another duty. He sends you across the sea to Darkshore with an urgent dispatch for Onu. From Darnassus, you can book a flight aboard a hippogryph.

South of Auberdine, you reach the Grove of the Ancients and deliver the missive to Onu. The towering Ancient of Lore accepts it quietly and remarks on Staghelm's impatience. Onu and the forest's ancient keepers believe all things unfold in their proper time. Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage embodied that patient wisdom, while Staghelm lacks it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

You will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah. Adventurer. How may Onu assist you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah. Thank you, friend. It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
